<!doctype html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>html,body{margin:0;width:216px;height:216px;overflow:hidden}canvas{display:block;width:216px;height:216px}</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene=new THREE.Scene();
const renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(216,216);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);
const ref=new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-108,108,108,-108,.1,1500);
ref.position.set(0,116,500);
ref.lookAt(0,108,0);

function group(parent,name){
  const g=new THREE.Group();g.name=name;parent.add(g);return g;
}
function material(color){return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness:.96});}
const gold=material(0xe3af34),belly=material(0xe6bb8e),paw=material(0x574937);
const black=material(0x21140e),lip=material(0x98652e),inside=material(0x120905),ivory=material(0xffebcc);
function mesh(parent,name,geo,mat){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);m.name=name;parent.add(m);return m;
}
function oval(parent,name,pos,size,mat){
  const m=mesh(parent,name,new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,40,32),mat);
  m.position.set(...pos);m.scale.set(...size);return m;
}
function loft(parent,name,rows,mat){
  const centers=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>new THREE.Vector3(r[1],r[0],r[2])),false,'catmullrom',.4);
  const radii=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(rows.map(r=>new THREE.Vector3(r[3],r[4],0)),false,'catmullrom',.4);
  const p=[],ix=[],N=64,M=8*(rows.length-1);
  for(let j=0;j<=M;j++){
    const c=centers.getPoint(j/M),r=radii.getPoint(j/M);
    for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
      const a=i*2*Math.PI/N;p.push(c.x+Math.cos(a)*r.x,c.y,c.z+Math.sin(a)*r.y);
    }
  }
  for(let j=0;j<M;j++)for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=j*N+i,b=j*N+(i+1)%N;ix.push(a,a+N,b,b,a+N,b+N);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));g.setIndex(ix);g.computeVertexNormals();return mesh(parent,name,g,mat);
}
function patch(parent,name,fn,mat){
  const pos=[],idx=[],N=80,M=18;
  for(let j=0;j<=M;j++)for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=i*2*Math.PI/N;pos.push(...fn(Math.cos(a)*j/M,Math.sin(a)*j/M));
  }
  for(let j=0;j<M;j++)for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
    const a=j*N+i,b=j*N+(i+1)%N;idx.push(a,a+N,b+N,a,b+N,b);
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setIndex(idx);g.computeVertexNormals();mat.side=THREE.DoubleSide;return mesh(parent,name,g,mat);
}
const character=group(scene,'laughing-golden-creature');
const trunk=group(character,'torso');
const sections=[
 [31,14,-3,.4,.4],[35,14,-3,19,17],[47,13,-3,36,30],[70,12,-3,44,35],
 [98,9,-4,45,33],[123,5,-5,43,31],[143,5,-6,38,28],[158,8,-5,29,23],[171,11,-3,12,12],[173,12,-3,.3,.3]];
loft(trunk,'pear-shaped-body',sections,gold);
function bodyFront(x,y){
  let i=0;while(i<sections.length-2&&sections[i+1][0]<y)i++;
  const a=sections[i],b=sections[i+1],t=(y-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]);
  const v=a.map((n,j)=>THREE.MathUtils.lerp(n,b[j],t));
  return v[2]+v[4]*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.01,1-((x-v[1])/v[3])**2));
}
patch(trunk,'cream-belly',(u,v)=>{
  const x=10+u*37-v*5,y=77+v*30-u*6;
  return [x,y,bodyFront(x,y)+1.1];
},belly);
const limbs=[];
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const side=s<0?'left':'right',leg=group(character,side+'-leg');
  loft(leg,'thigh-and-shin',[
    [-54,18+s*34,-5,.2,.2],[-48,18+s*34,-5,11,12],[-15,19+s*34,-3,13,16],
    [9,19+s*35,0,16,19],[33,18+s*33,-2,20,23],[51,16+s*29,-5,19,21],[62,15+s*27,-5,.4,.4]],gold);
  const arm=group(character,side+'-arm');
  const rows=s<0?[[44,-20,18,5,7],[52,-23,15,7,9],[72,-29,9,9,12],[94,-34,4,8,14],[118,-32,0,11,17],[137,-27,-1,13,16],[151,-20,-3,9,10],[156,-17,-4,.4,.4]]:
    [[38,52,21,8,8],[47,54,19,12,13],[63,60,14,17,18],[82,64,8,24,23],[103,61,2,24,24],[123,49,-3,24,23],[144,37,-5,20,19],[157,29,-5,13,13],[163,25,-4,.4,.4]];
  const skin=loft(arm,'hanging-arm',rows,gold);
  const hand=group(arm,side+'-hand'),hx=s<0?-21:51,hy=s<0?40:33;
  hand.position.set(hx,hy,22);hand.rotation.z=s<0?-.15:.13;
  oval(hand,'palm',[0,0,1],[s<0?7:10,9,6],paw);
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const spread=i-1.5,f=oval(hand,'finger-'+i,[spread*(s<0?3.5:5.3),-7+Math.abs(spread),4],[2.45,7.8-Math.abs(spread),3],paw);
    f.rotation.z=spread*.15;f.rotation.x=-.18;
  }
  const thumb=oval(hand,'thumb',[-s*9,0,4],[3.1,7,3.3],paw);thumb.rotation.z=-s*.46;
  limbs.push({s,leg,skin,rest:skin.geometry.attributes.position.array.slice(),hand,hx,hy,lo:rows[0][0],hi:rows.at(-1)[0]});
}
const head=group(character,'head');
oval(head,'golden-head',[0,0,0],[29,37,25],gold);
function surface(x,y){return 25*Math.sqrt(Math.max(.025,1-(x/29)**2-(y/37)**2));}
const eyes=group(head,'closed-eyes');
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  patch(eyes,'curved-eyelid',(u,v)=>{
    const x=s*17+u*7,y=22+3.7*(1-u*u)+v*1.75-s*u*.8;
    return [x,y,surface(x,y)+.65];
  },black);
}
const mouth=group(head,'open-laughing-mouth');
function mouthXY(u,v){return [u*(15.6+4.6*v),-3+18.9*v+3.4*u*u];}
patch(mouth,'outer-lip',(u,v)=>{const [x,y]=mouthXY(u*1.13,v*1.12);return [x,y,surface(x,y)+.68];},lip);
patch(mouth,'dark-mouth-cavity',(u,v)=>{const [x,y]=mouthXY(u,v);return [x,y,surface(x,y)+1.05];},inside);
function toothBand(name,left,right,top,bottom){
  const p=[],ix=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=50;i++){
    const t=i/50,x=left+(right-left)*t;
    for(const y of [bottom(t),top(t)])p.push(x,y,surface(x,y)+1.6);
    if(i){const a=2*i-2;ix.push(a,a+2,a+1,a+1,a+2,a+3);}
  }
  const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(p,3));g.setIndex(ix);g.computeVertexNormals();ivory.side=THREE.DoubleSide;mesh(mouth,name,g,ivory);
}
toothBand('upper-row-of-teeth',-15,15,t=>11+4.3*Math.sin(Math.PI*t),t=>8+4.6*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)-.7*Math.cos(10*Math.PI*t));
toothBand('lower-teeth',-8.8,9,t=>-13-3.2*Math.sin(Math.PI*t)+.7*Math.cos(6*Math.PI*t),t=>-14.2-5.2*Math.sin(Math.PI*t));
for(const s of [-1,1]){
  const x=s*13.8,y=9.3;oval(mouth,'corner-tooth',[x,y,surface(x,y)+1.65],[1.35,2.9,1.15],ivory);
}
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffbee,0xd3b89d,1.78));
function light(x,y,z,color,power){
  const l=new THREE.DirectionalLight(color,power);l.position.set(x,y,z);scene.add(l);
}
light(-85,180,90,0xfff4da,2);light(120,95,-70,0xfff8e4,1.3);
const bg=document.createElement('canvas');bg.width=bg.height=64;
const ctx=bg.getContext('2d'),grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,64);
grad.addColorStop(0,'#f6f7f3');grad.addColorStop(.74,'#f8faf7');grad.addColorStop(1,'#dedfdc');
ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fillRect(0,0,64,64);
const tex=new THREE.CanvasTexture(bg);tex.colorSpace=THREE.SRGBColorSpace;scene.background=tex;

// Head center and orientation, trunk compression, shoulder drift and wrist offsets.
const poses=[
 [0,14,167,0,-.16,-.19,0,0,0,0,0,0],
 [180,11,127,.24,-.25,-.06,.93,1,-15,-14,-2,-9],
 [340,16,169,-.65,-.28,-.05,-.10,2,-5,-2,-2,2],
 [520,-8,162,-.10,-.39,.30,.04,-6,-1,-1,-1,0],
 [680,-6,112,.24,-.43,.26,1,-4,-18,-17,-5,-9],
 [860,7,163,-.80,-.49,.12,-.04,-3,-11,-5,-7,-1],
 [1020,-10,154,-.12,-.50,.10,.11,-9,-4,-4,-7,-4],
 [1200,-16,116,.24,-.52,.48,.98,-8,-20,-16,-13,-10]
];
function render(t){
  const time=((t%1220)+1220)%1220;
  let k=0;while(k<7&&poses[k+1][0]<=time)k++;
  const a=poses[k],b=poses[(k+1)%8],u=(time-a[0])/((k===7?1220:b[0])-a[0]);
  const w=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const [,x,y,pitch,yaw,roll,c,shift,lx,ly,rx,ry]=a.map((v,i)=>v+(b[i]-v)*w);
  head.position.set(x,y,3+12*c);head.rotation.order='ZXY';head.rotation.set(pitch,yaw,roll,'ZXY');
  head.scale.set(1+.02*c,1-.14*c,1);
  trunk.scale.set(1+.13*c,1-.23*c,1+.10*c);
  trunk.rotation.z=-shift/150;
  trunk.position.set(shift*.12,-14*c,0);
  for(const {s,leg,skin,rest,hand,hx,hy,lo,hi} of limbs){
    const dx=s<0?lx:rx,dy=s<0?ly:ry;
    hand.position.set(hx+dx,hy+dy,22+9*c);
    hand.rotation.z=(s<0?-.15:.13)+s*.17*c;
    leg.position.set(dx*.63,-12*c,2*c);
    leg.rotation.z=-s*.15*c;
    const attr=skin.geometry.attributes.position;
    for(let i=0;i<attr.count;i++){
      const j=i*3,ay=rest[j+1],v=(ay-lo)/(hi-lo),bend=Math.sin(Math.PI*v);
      attr.setXYZ(i,rest[j]+dx*(1-v)+shift*v+s*(s<0?10:13)*bend*c,
        ay+dy*(1-v)-50*c*v,rest[j+2]+c*(9-5*v));
    }
    attr.needsUpdate=true;skin.geometry.computeVertexNormals();skin.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  }
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
render(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
